text:
Nina: dropped a quick Figma for the diff timeline + scorecard deep-link. scrubber, compact markers, hover tooltips. want quick UX/a11y nits before i hand to eng.
Raj: Looks good. contrast: active marker blue reads low on light canvas. bump to a darker token or add a white stroke.
Ellen: keyboard: left/right to step, enter to open detail, visible focus ring. add aria-live: "Diff X of Y: regression in <test-name>". Also trap focus when side panel open.
Miro: overlapping markers -> cluster pill (+N) that expands a tiny list. keep hover previews for single markers. on mobile, make scrubber touch target >=44px.
Tess: copy nit: primary CTA "Show changes" feels vague. suggest "View regression details". resolved state: use "No regression detected".
EvalBot: eval run 2034 attached. summary: 8 diffs, 2 regressions. backend PR #503 will emit timeline events.
Nina: will update Figma with darkened active state, aria snippets, cluster pill behavior, and add a small "Open in scorecard" deep-link. ping when PR is up. :sparkles:
